sources.sch: docs/adafruit-pcb/Adafruit ESP8266 Feather rev G.sch (CC BY-SA 3.0): JP1 = 16-pin header (pin 1 at the TX end), JP3 = 12-pin header (pin 1 = BAT)
sources.ds: Espressif ESP8266EX datasheet v7.1, Table 2-1 and notes (docs/local, docs/README.md)

L1.note: ESP chip enable, 10 kΩ pull-up (R2); grounding it powers the ESP8266 down. Other Feathers leave this pin NC.

L2.note: USB serial TX, wired to the CP2104 RXD; must not be low at power-up
L2.source: sch net TXD = JP1.2, IC1.RXD; ds note on U0TXD

L3.note: USB serial RX, driven by the CP2104 TXD through 1 kΩ (R11)
L3.source: sch net RXD = JP1.3, R11 - USB_RX - IC1.TXD

L7.note: A5 on other Feathers; not connected on the HUZZAH ESP8266

L8.note: A4 on other Feathers; not connected

L9.note: A3 on other Feathers; not connected

L10.note: A2 on other Feathers; not connected

L11.note: A1 on other Feathers; not connected

L12.note: 0-1.0 V analog input, no divider; not a digital pin
L12.source: sch net ADC = JP1.12, X3.ADC; ds Table 2-1 pin 6 TOUT

L14.note: AREF on other Feathers; not connected

L16.note: ESP reset (10 kΩ pull-up R3, reset button SW2, auto-reset Q1); grounding it resets the ESP8266
L16.source: sch net RESET = JP1.16, R3, SW2, Q1.C

S2.note: 3.3 V regulator enable (10 kΩ pull-up R1); low turns the Feather off
S2.source: sch net EN = JP3.2, U2.EN, R1

S7.note: boot strap (must be low at boot) with a 4.7 kΩ pull-down (R7): against TinyG's 2.7 kΩ pull-up the open line sits near 2.2 V, so it can never present an open contact and can stop the ESP booting
S7.source: sch net GPIO15 = JP3.7, R7.G$1; ds strap note (MTDO); target tinyg-v8 input

S8.note: boot strap (must be high at boot); red LED D3 via 4.7 kΩ; pulled low by the auto-reset transistor Q2 when DTR is asserted alone (flashing)
S8.source: sch net GPIO0 = JP3.8, Q2.C, R7.G$2 - D3; ds strap note

S9.note: no pin interrupt (irrelevant here); not tied to RST
S9.source: sch net GPIO16 = JP3.9 only; ds Table 2-1 pin 8 XPD_DCDC

S10.note: boot strap (must be high at boot); 10 kΩ pull-up (R2); the ESP-12 module's blue LED
S10.source: sch net GPIO2 = JP3.10, R2.G$2; ds strap note
